turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, is this Mrs. Banerjee from Nagpur?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Vikram from the International Logistics Wing. We have an imported package for you, but it has been flagged by customs for an unpaid duty.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Package? I am not expecting any parcel from abroad.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is marked as an urgent gift, but since the tax is unpaid, we cannot release it. If it stays in the warehouse for another two hours, it will be sent back and you will face a legal penalty.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Penalty? But please check again, there must be some mistake.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Madam, there is no mistake. You just need to pay a clearance fee of twenty five thousand rupees to settle the customs account immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: That is a very large amount. How do I pay this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will send you a UPI QR code on WhatsApp right now. Just scan it and send the payment, otherwise the parcel will be seized.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I don't know how to use QR codes, can I come to your office?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Our office is at the airport cargo terminal and not open to public. Just ask your son to do the UPI transfer for you quickly.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me call him first then.
